notes: Clock widget can now switch between Digital and Analog from Control Center → Clock Style. Analog face is minimal: 60 minute marks (cardinals in gold, hours in white, minutes faint), white hour and minute hands, gold seconds hand and center dot. Seconds hand sweeps smoothly via requestAnimationFrame — no ticking. Scales huge in Zen edition; fits naturally in any other slot.
